newsitem.title: INDIA: 20 Kashmiri journalists injured in clashes.
newsitem.headline: 20 Kashmiri journalists injured in clashes.

text.p: At least 20 Kashmiri journalists were injured on Friday when police tear gassed and baton charged their procession.
Witnesses said police also fired shots in the air to disperse the journalists, who were protesting over the police use of force against reporters covering a women's demonstration earlier in the day.

Half a dozen reporters were beaten up in the earlier clash near the United Nations Military Observer Office in Srinagar. One received serious injuries and at least six women were also injured and two arrested, witnesses said.
Farooq Abdullah, chief minister of the troubled Jammu and Kashmir state, told the agitated journalists: "This is an unfortunate incident, I will order an inquiry into the incident," Abdullah said.
At least five journalists have been killed in the valley and dozens have escaped attempts on their lives by gunmen during a seven-year-old rebellion in Kashmir.
